"Create a fully playable Idle Clicker RPG where players level up their character, fight monsters, collect loot, and upgrade their equipment.

Core Features:

- Combat: Click enemies to deal damage or unlock auto-attacks. Defeat monsters and bosses to earn XP, gold, and equipment.
- Leveling: Gain XP, level up, increase your stats, and unlock stronger enemies and new areas.
- Loot System: Enemies drop random weapons and armor with different stats and rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythic.
- Equipment: Equip weapons, helmets, chest armor, gloves, boots, rings, and necklaces to increase your power.
- Item Fusion: Combine 3 items of the same equipment type and rarity to create 1 item of the next rarity. Higher rarities provide better stats and special abilities.
- Inventory: Manage, equip, sell, sort, and combine items. Show item stats and compare equipment.
- Upgrades: Spend gold to improve damage, attack speed, critical hits, XP gain, and loot chances.
- Bosses @COMMENT_BODY@ Zones: Fight increasingly powerful enemies, defeat bosses, unlock new areas, and discover better loot.
- Idle Progression: Automatically fight enemies and earn rewards while offline.
- Saving: Automatically save progress so players can continue later.

Visual Style: Create a polished dark fantasy RPG interface with animated combat, floating damage numbers, glowing rare items, satisfying loot drops, and smooth menus.

Important: Build a complete, functional game, not just a prototype or design document. All systems must work together, the game must be playable immediately, and the code should be easy to expand with new content.
"

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, polished, fully playable dark-fantasy idle clicker RPG in the empty PlayGround repo, with clicking/auto-combat, leveling, loot/rarities, equipment, fusion, inventory, upgrades, bosses/zones, offline progress, and saving.

## Requirements
- Combat: click enemies, unlock auto-attacks, fight monsters/bosses for XP, gold, and equipment.
- Leveling: gain XP, increase stats, unlock stronger enemies/new areas.
- Loot: random weapons/armor across Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic rarities.
- Equipment: weapon, helmet, chest, gloves, boots, ring, necklace.
- Fusion: combine 3 same-type/same-rarity items into 1 next-rarity item; higher rarities have better stats/abilities.
- Inventory: equip, sell, sort, combine, inspect stats, compare against equipped gear.
- Upgrades: gold-spendable damage, attack speed, crit, XP gain, loot chance.
- Bosses/zones, idle/offline progression, automatic saving.
- Visual style: polished dark fantasy, animated combat, floating damage, glowing rare items, satisfying drops, smooth menus.
- Important: complete functional game, not a prototype/design doc; systems must work together; easy to expand.

## Decisions
- Implemented as dependency-free static site: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/data.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/art.js`, `js/ui.js`.
- No build tooling; served directly by the existing static runtime.
- Hand-built inline SVG monster art and icon sprite to avoid external asset dependence.
- All content mostly data-driven via `js/data.js` for easy expansion.
- Offline rewards capped at 8 hours, auto-simulated only after Auto-Strike unlock and if auto is enabled.
- Hero defeat no longer resets boss/enemy HP, guaranteeing eventual idle progression.
- Save key: `ashen-oath-save-v1`.
- Local server running in tmux session `ashen` on `PORT=3000` via `./start.sh`.
- Playwright Chromium was installed with `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full game logic: combat, crits, lifesteal/heal effects, enemy attacks, defeat/revive, levels, XP curve, bosses every 10 kills, zone unlocks, world map travel.
- Loot generation with six rarities, seven slots, randomized stats, rare+ affixes, item power/sell value.
- Inventory, equipment swapping, item comparison modal, selling, bulk-sell commons, sorting.
- Forge/fusion with 3-to-1 same slot+rarity, next rarity, result modal.
- Gold upgrades for damage, speed, crit, XP, loot, plus one-time Auto-Strike purchase/toggle.
- Offline simulation, automatic saves, save/load sanitization, reset flow.
- UI: dark fantasy 3-column desktop, responsive mobile layout, animated arena/background/embers, SVG monsters per zone, damage numbers, crit flashes, loot beams, boss banners, toasts, modals.
- Audio effects via WebAudio, toggleable, plus help/settings/map/victory/offline modals.
- Verified desktop screenshots: initial state, forge, upgrades, map, boss, victory, zone 2, item comparison.
- Verified actions: attacks, kills, XP/leveling, Auto-Strike unlock, fusion, equipment, travel, boss defeat, zone unlock.
- Fixed runtime issues: missing `Game.isPaused` export, favicon 404, stale UI after travel while modal was open, clipped combat log, truncated equipment names.

### Active
- Mobile layout QA in progress. A 390×844 screenshot shows combat first and side panel below; top bar and controls fit, but the mobile page was not yet fully scrolled/tested.
- Need final regression pass for remaining edge cases, especially offline modal, save/reload, final-zone behavior, and mobile modals.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the mobile screenshot/layout further; ensure inventory/forge/upgrades and modals are usable at 390px width and safe-area friendly.
2. Test offline flow by setting `lastSeen` back, saving/reloading, and confirming the offline summary grants gold/XP/items correctly.
3. Test save/reload persistence across all systems and ensure no console errors after a fresh session.
4. Verify boss/victory modal, travel, and pending-victory interactions do not leave stale UI.
5. Test full zones beyond Gloomfang and final-zone boss messaging.
6. Re-check desktop 1440×900 and mobile screenshots after final fixes.
7. Remove generated `screenshots/` if undesired (already gitignored).

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: app markup, SVG icon sprite, modal shell, static panels.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full dark-fantasy styling, responsive rules, animations, modal/layout fixes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: rarities, slots, affixes, upgrades, zones, bosses, balance config.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: state, combat, loot, equipment, forge, saving/offline, public `window.Game` API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/art.js`: inline SVG monster illustrations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: rendering, events, modals, toasts, effects, audio, `window.Game` hooks.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/favicon.svg`: added favicon.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: QA screenshots (`desktop.png`, `mobile.png`, `victory.png`, etc.), gitignored.

## Important Context
- Start server: `tmux new-session -d -s ashen 'cd /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround && PORT=3000 ./start.sh > /tmp/ashen.log 2>&1'`.
- Browser commands: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3000`, `playwright-cli resize 1440 900`, `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/file.png`.
- Current saved test state has progressed to Gloomfang Wood, around level 9, with Auto-Strike unlocked and several items.
- A recent mobile screenshot at 390×844 shows battle first, side panel below; equipment wraps names properly, but mobile side-panel scroll and modal usability still need verification.
- `hooks.render` now always calls `renderAll`; `closeModal()` also re-renders to prevent stale UI after travel/actions.
- `Game.isPaused` is now exported.
- Offline simulation uses `state.lastSeen`, caps at 8h, max 1200 rewarded kills, and up to 9 recovered items.
- Final implementation remains uncommitted; repo starts with no existing app source.

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.

"Create a fully playable Idle Clicker RPG where players level up their character, fight monsters, collect loot, and upgrade their equipment.

Core Features:

- Combat: Click enemies to deal damage or unlock auto-attacks. Defeat monsters and bosses to earn XP, gold, and equipment.
- Leveling: Gain XP, level up, increase your stats, and unlock stronger enemies and new areas.

- Equipment: Equip weapons, helmets, chest armor, gloves, boots, rings, and necklaces to increase your power.
- Item Fusion: Combine 3 items of the same equipment type and rarity to create 1 item of the next rarity. Higher rarities provide better stats and special abilities.

- Upgrades: Spend gold to improve damage, attack speed, critical hits, XP gain, and loot chances.

- Idle Progression: Automatically fight enemies and earn rewards while offline.
- Saving: Automatically save progress so players can continue later.

Visual Style: Create a polished dark fantasy RPG interface with animated combat, floating damage numbers, glowing rare items, satisfying loot drops, and smooth menus.

Important: Build a complete, functional game, not just a prototype or design document. All systems must work together, the game must be playable immediately, and the code should be easy to expand with new content.
"
